Alex: semifinal questions 1
Nina: ohhh big week. who s everyone starting at flex?
Sam: debating between Ty Johnson and Z. Moss. Johnson's been hot but Moss has the matchup.
Ravi: quick poll: 1) Johnson 2) Moss 3) Other (reply)
Claire: 3 1 starting D. Williams instead (gonna be spicy)
Alex: lol Claire living on the edge. why Williams?
Claire: matchup looks sweet and volume > upside. also weather in NE could be rain delay.
Nina: weather note appreciated. link: https://weather.com/game-center
Sam: also bench notice 1 waivers close at 10:30pm ET.
Alex: ok meta play: here's a 30s projection I made (very rough):
```
# projected fantasy pts (half ppr)
Ty Johnson,14.2
Zack Moss,11.6
D. Williams,9.8
```
Ravi: Alex that script slaps. putting Johnson in.
Nina: I m team captain so I m benching Moss and starting Johnson.
Claire: if Johnson tanks you owe me breakfast. :pancakes:
Sam: deal. also reminder: trade veto deadline is tomorrow noon if anyone's still tinkering.
Alex: final vote tally: Johnson 3, Moss 0, Other 2. consensus: Johnson in.
Nina: gl all. next thread if Johnson explodes ;)
Ravi: good luck! may the highest floor win. :trophy:
